verdict.rationale: Bitbucket ships its own CI/CD, Bitbucket Pipelines, with hosted or private runners for automated workflows. It also lets users trigger AI-powered workflows directly from a pipeline (feature-flag cleanup, docs updates, release notes, flaky-test fixes) and offers Rovo access from the terminal, so the core of headless, CI-driven automation is covered. missing for 10: documented headless CLI/API usage for driving Bitbucket itself (the OpenAPI probe found nothing), technical depth beyond marketing-page claims, independent or hands-on corroboration.
